text.p: Hurricane Warnings from Zijuatanejo to Manzanillo along the southwest coast of Mexico. Tropical Storm Warnings from Manzanillo north to San Blas.
Hurricane Hernan is currently centered near the coast of Mexico near Punta Tejupan, moving northwest at 10 mph. Top winds, now 85 mph, may drop off slightly as the storm interacts with land.
Rainfall of 5-10 inches, higher in the mountains, will occur with this storm, producing life-threatening fhasl floods and mudslides. Storm surge waves of up to 5 feet above normal tides are likely.

Typhoon Zane is only a threat to shipping 500-600 miles southeast of Japan at this time. The storm is moving rapidly east northeast at 22 mph and has top winds near 75 mph, which will weaken as the storm moves out to sea this period.

Disturbed weather in the western Gulf of Mexico is of some concern to shipping. Gusty winds and rough seas may cause a few minor problems. This area is being watched as it may develop to a tropical depression this period.
